name: Simon
description: Son of Mattathias, called Thassi; named by his father on his deathbed a man of counsel and “a father” to his brethren

points: “I know that your brother Simon is a man of counsel, give ear unto him alway: he shall be a father unto you.” He didn’t say I think; he said I know. Mattathias knew his sons.

note.label: The War Between Blacks And Whites

points: “Now they that were with Simon, being led with covetousness, were persuaded for money”. A lot of you are going to leave for money. They “took seventy thousand drachms, and let some of them escape”: they let the enemies go, through money.
